remarks: Welcome to 50 Aiken St in the highly sought-after Rolling Ridge Complex! This beautifully renovated ranch-style condo offers the perfect blend of modern convenience and peaceful surroundings. With 990 sq ft of thoughtfully designed living space, this 2-bedroom, 1-bath unit features an open-concept layout that's ideal for contemporary living. Step inside to discover brand-new carpet and fresh paint throughout the spacious living and dining rooms. The dining area opens to a private deck that overlooks a tranquil, wooded area - a perfect spot for relaxation or entertaining. The updated kitchen and bathroom boast luxurious finishes, including a new vanity, fixtures, and stylish design touches. Both bedrooms are generously sized and share easy access to the well-appointed bath. The unit also includes in-unit laundry and a basement storage area, adding both convenience and functionality. Community amenities are a highlight with access to a serene in-ground pool at the edge of the pond, plus paddle tennis courts for outdoor enjoyment. The monthly common charges cover heat, hot water, and water, making for worry-free living. Location is key here, the Rolling Ridge Complex is tucked away in a private, quiet neighborhood yet conveniently close to major routes like the Route 7 Connector, Merritt Parkway, and I-95. You'll be just moments away from fine dining, shopping, and more. This is an exceptional opportunity to own in one of the most desirable communities in the area.
